verdict.rationale: TeamViewer's pricing page lists 'Auditability (audit log and API)', and it offers a Web API, which suggests audit data can be reached programmatically. An incident responder also reports analyzing TeamViewer connection logs, which independently confirms that per-connection logs exist. The evidence is only a one-line pricing mention, though, with no documentation of what fields are logged or how export works. Missing for 10: documented log fields (who, which device, when), a documented export format or audit-log API endpoint, and admin-console log viewing details.
